headline: Last session: Sensex drops 318 points, Nifty falls below 25,150 snapping three-day rally due to rate hike fears.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Rate hike fears weighed heavily on market sentiment during the last session.
Concerns over inflation triggered profit booking across major sectors.
Global market volatility and Nvidia crisis added pressure on indices.
Investors locked in gains following a three-day market rally.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped 318 points while Nifty50 closed at 25,144 in the last session.
Shriram Finance emerged as the top loser on the benchmark index.
Deepak Fertilisers reported an 85% surge in Q2 net profit to Rs 394 crore.
ITC hiked prices for its Gold Flake and Classic Connect cigarette brands.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian equity markets snapped a three-day rally as the Sensex fell 318 points and Nifty slipped below 25,150 amid rate hike fears and inflation concerns. Shriram Finance and Manappuram Finance saw significant selling pressure. Meanwhile, Deepak Fertilisers surged on strong Q2 profit growth and ITC announced price hikes across key brands.
